ns2:course.label: Dev of Air and Space Power I
ns2:course.description: (AFAS 121) Historical survey of trends, events, and policies that led to the emergence of air power through the Korean Conflict. Also provides an introduction to basic leadership and management skills, ethical decision making, and basic communication skills. Requires concurrent enrollment with AFAS 102. Prerequisite: AFAS 112 or consent of instructor.
